text.en:
Section fifteen hundred and seventy-seven of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven,
known as the Revised Administrative Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1577. Record to be kept by physicians, pharmacists, dentists, and veterinarians-Inspection of
same.-Physicians, dentists, veterinarians, pharmacists, and second-class pharmacists shall keep true and
correct records of all prohibited drugs received and dispensed or transferred by them, in such form and
manner as may be prescribed in the regulations of the Bureau of Internal Revenue.
"Such record and the stock of prohibited drugs on hand shall be subject to inspection at all times by the duly
authorized officers, agents or deputies of the Bureau of Internal Revenue who shall be qualified physicians or
pharmacists legally practising their profession."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 21, 1921.
